title: Forecasting implied volatility surface with generative diffusion models
abstract: arXiv:2511.07571v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We introduce a conditional Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM) for generating one-day-ahead approximately arbitrage-free implied volatility surfaces. To capture the path-dependent nature of volatility dynamics, we condition our model on a set of market variables, including exponentially weighted moving averages (EWMAs) of historical vol-surfaces, returns and squared returns of the underlying asset, and scalar risk indicators associated with the underlying asset. A key challenge is that the historical data used for training often contain arbitrage opportunities, particularly in the earlier part of the sample, which conflicts with the goal of generating arbitrage-free surfaces. We address this by using a weighting scheme based on the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) to incorporate the arbitrage penalty into the loss function. translated_title: 基于生成式扩散模型的隐含波动率曲面预测
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种条件去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM），用于生成未来一日的近似无套利隐含波动率曲面。为捕捉波动率动态的路径依赖特性，我们以一组市场变量作为模型的条件输入，包括历史波动率曲面的指数加权移动平均（EWMA）、标的资产的收益率与平方收益率，以及与标的资产相关的标量风险指标。一个关键挑战在于，用于训练的历史数据往往包含套利机会，尤其是在样本的早期部分，这与生成无套利曲面的目标相冲突。为此，我们采用一种基于信噪比（SNR）的加权方案，将套利惩罚项纳入损失函数，该方案能够在扩散过程中动态调整惩罚强度。通过数值实验（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 本文提出一种条件去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM），通过基于信噪比的动态套利惩罚加权方案，生成未来一日近似无套利的隐含波动率曲面。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a conditional DDPM that generates one-day-ahead approximately arbitrage-free implied volatility surfaces, using an SNR-based weighting scheme to dynamically incorporate arbitrage penalties during the diffusion process.
